description: Search for a few new people (5 by default, up to 50) matching the account targeting (see get_icp; change it with update_targeting or add_exclusion first if the user wants someone else). Runs in the background for two to five minutes and puts the people found in the review queue: nobody is saved until approve_leads. Counts against the weekly discovery allowance. Call get_search_status to follow it, then list_search_results.

count.description: How many people to find: 5, 10, 20 or 50. Start small and search again for more.

name.description: A name for this search. It titles its list and its section in a sequence. Defaults to the targeting name.

name: find_leads
title: Find leads (Deep Search)
